affected_boundaries: local permission update to foreign project configuration

observed_behavior: ponytail update-permissions in one repository failed when an unrelated registered repository had uncommitted project configuration.
expected_behavior: A local permission update reads only the invoking worktree's project proposal and preserves foreign accepted contributions without opening foreign worktrees.
causal_mechanism: The high-level command enumerated every registered blessed worktree and the V1 compiler reconstructed policy by rereading every listed project path.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A local command reconstructs shared accepted output from every producer's current live configuration.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Unrelated availability, dirt, or malformed configuration becomes a prerequisite for an otherwise independent local operation.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: A local update opens only its invoking worktree; foreign contributions come exclusively from durable accepted snapshots.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Store exact per-project accepted proposals, replace only the invoking project's snapshot, and migrate lossy legacy provenance without dereferencing recorded paths.

applicability_conditions: A user-level aggregate is assembled from independently managed projects.
An update should change one producer without requiring the current state of other producers.
known_non_matches: An explicit repository-inventory validation command whose contract is to validate every registered project.
confirmation_evidence: Before the repair, the focused regression observed accepted-state V1 aggregation and blessed-worktree selection.
After the repair, local update and check pass while the foreign project is dirty, and V1 migration passes with a missing foreign path.
regression_proofs: tests/ponytail-cli.test.js: update-permissions reads only the invoking project and preserves accepted foreign snapshots
tests/ponytail-cli.test.js: update-permissions reads policy from the invoking worktree instead of the blessed worktree
tests/condense-codex-rules.test.js: upgrades V1 accepted state without reading foreign project worktrees
